item.title: Weren
item.description:
Weren

No puedes pasar por alto a un weren (pronunciado “wear-enn”). Con una altura de 2,2 metros y un peso de 180 kilogramos, están cubiertos de un pelaje espeso con una gran melena y poderosas garras.

Historia

Provenientes del mundo de Kurg, los weren fueron descubiertos por los humanos durante su versión del Renacimiento: una época de aprendizaje, imprentas y armas de chispa. A pesar de su era de iluminación, los weren estaban envueltos en una guerra global, manteniéndolos agudos y listos para la batalla. Son una dicotomía: eruditos ilustrados en un momento, nobles salvajes al siguiente.

item.title: Acto
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a talent for playing a part or assuming a dramatic role. It also covers impersonation and the techniques of stage and screen.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 4 [Disguise]: Use stage and film makeup and techniques to change appearance or look like someone else.
  • Applying a Disguise: Requires a complex skill check (Ordinary, Good, or Amazing complexity). If successful, observers receive a penalty to Awareness checks: +1 (Ordinary), +2 (Good), +3 (Amazing).
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality performance.
    Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality performance.
    Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece performance.

item.title: Ancla dimensional
item.description: The ability to prevent others from teleporting into or out of a specific area.

item.title: Arco
item.description: With the bow skill, a hero can become increasingly more proficient with the long bow and the short bow. A bow can be loaded and fired in the same action by any character.

item.title: Arma biológica
item.description:
Extended duration.

When employing this skill, a character generates a staff or club of biokinetic energy that can be used as a melee weapon (requires Melee Attack-bludgeon).

The bioweapon has a damage rating of d4/d4+2/d6+2. The initial skill check used to generate the weapon determines the type of damage:

  • Ordinary: stun
  • Good: wound
  • Amazing: mortal

item.title: Arma de energía
item.description: Proficiency with lasers, blasters, and other high-tech energy projectors.

item.title: Arma de fuego
item.description: Proficiency with traditional slug-throwers.

item.title: Arma potenciada
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with any powered melee weapon—a chain sword, gravmace, star sword, pulse baton, or any other melee weapon that uses energy to enhance its performance and damage capability.

item.title: Armadura de combate
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his ability to perform actions, including parrying with a shield, while wearing standard combat armor, by a gradual process of learning to compensate for the weight and awkwardness of the heavy armor. A character with this skill at rank 1, 2, or 3 is allowed to reduce the action check and Dexterity resistance modifier penalty associated with combat armor (not powered armor) by 1 additional step.

item.title: Armadura potenciada
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with powered combat armor, becoming able to efficiently employ the strength enhancements built into powered armor. A character with this skill at rank 1, 2, or 3 is allowed to reduce the action check and Dexterity resistance modifier penalty associated with combat armor (not powered armor) by 1 additional step.

item.title: Armas
item.description: Operate shipboard weapon systems. Used to pick targets and make attacks in vehicle combat.

item.title: Artes marciales de poder
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to learn one of the many disciplines of unarmed combat that emphasize the use of muscles and bones for power. Direct movements and offensive attacks predominate. The power martial arts skill encompasses combat styles such as karate and tae kwon do.

A hero with this skill enjoys improved damage on a successful unarmed attack: d6s/d6+2s/d4w, plus any Strength bonuses.

item.title: Artes marciales defensivas
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill encompasses styles such as aikido and tai chi chuan, focusing on fluid, circular movements to redirect an attacker’s force.

A character can use throws, sweeps, flips, and holds to cause stun damage (d4s/d4+1s/d4+2s, LI). It may also enable a hero to knock an opponent to the ground.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 2 [Block]: Attempt to block or counter an unarmed attack. The success must be equal to or greater than the attacker’s success. Requires an available action in the current phase.
  • Rank 4 [Reaction Block]: Attempt to block whenever any unarmed attack is directed against the hero, using the character’s next available action (in the current or following round).
  • Rank 4, 8, 12 [Resistance Modifier]: The hero’s Strength resistance modifier improves by +1 at each of these ranks.

item.title: Astrogación, Drivespace
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill involves navigation through drivespace, usually movement between star systems.

Starfall Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “Drivespace Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Arrive at the edge of the destination star system.
  • Good: Arrive inside destination star system, d12+2 AUs from target.
  • Amazing: Arrive inside destination system, d4 AUs from target.

item.title: Astrogación, Sistema
item.description:
This specialty skill involves navigation through normal space, usually within a star system.

System Astrogation Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “System/Surface Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Course is plotted at normal travel time plus d4 time units.
  • Good: Course is plotted at normal travel time.
  • Amazing: Course is plotted that cuts travel time by 1 time unit.

item.title: Astronomía
item.description:
Astronomy is the study of the universe beyond a hero’s planet of origin, specifically observations of celestial bodies and phenomena.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 step at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Bailar
item.description:
The dance skill represents a talent for moving rhythmically to music by following set steps or by improvisation. It also covers technical aspects such as choreography. Dance can be used to entertain, tell a story, or impress an audience.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality dance.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality dance.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece dance.

item.title: Ballesta
item.description: With the crossbow skill, a hero can become increasingly more proficient with this type of primitive weapon. It takes one action to load a crossbow and a separate action to fire the weapon.

item.title: Beneficios de rango
item.description:
• Improved Operation: At rank 4, 8 and 12, a character with the combat armor or powered armor skill can reduce the action check and Dexterity resistance modifier penalty of the appropriate type of armor by one additional step.
  • Shaking Off Stuns: A character with the combat armor skill at rank 5 or higher can attempt to “shake off” some of the stun damage he suffers in combat. Once per round, the character can make a skill check; an Ordinary result allows him to ignore 1 point of stun damage inflicted in that round, a Good result allows him to ignore up to 2 points, and an Amazing result allows him to ignore up to 4 points.

item.title: Beneficios de rango
item.description:
• Resistance Modifier: The hero’s Dexterity resistance modifier improves by +1 at rank 3, by +1 again at rank 7, and by +1 again at rank 11.
  • Reaction Parry: At rank 4, a hero with a Melee Weapons specialty skill can make a “reaction parry” as his first action in a round, allowing him to parry an attack made in a phase earlier than his own.
  • Double-Strike: At rank 6, a hero can make two attacks as a single action (+2 penalty).
    • Ordinary: 1 attack, normal damage.
    • Good: 2 attacks, normal damage.
    • Amazing: 2 attacks, Good damage.
  • Multistrike: At rank 12, an Amazing success on a Double-Strike allows three attacks that each inflict Good damage.

item.title: Beneficios de rango
item.description: • Rank 3, 6, 9, 12: Grants an increasing situational bonus to related checks.

item.title: Beneficios de rango (todas las especialidades)
item.description:
• Rank 2 [No Hands]: A hero can inflict normal unarmed damage with a head butt, kick, or other attack that doesn’t involve his hands.
  • Rank 3, 6, 9, 12 [Increased Damage]: The hero adds +1 to his Unarmed Attack damage at each of these ranks.
  • Rank 5 [Knockout]: A hero can make a knockout attack (+4 penalty). If the attack succeeds, it inflicts normal stun damage and forces the target to make a Resolve-physical resolve check with a penalty equal to the number of stun points inflicted. If this check fails, the target is knocked out for d6 rounds.
  • Overpowering: The Unarmed Attack skill is also used to determine the success of an attempt to overpower an opponent. Every additional attacker who takes part in the same overpowering attempt provides a cumulative -1 bonus to the skill check. Overpowering does not cause damage, but it immobilizes an opponent.

item.title: Biología, Botánica, Zoología
item.description:
These specialty skills must be purchased separately.

  • Biology: The study of organisms and biochemical processes.
  • Botany: The study of plants and identification.
  • Zoology: The study of animals and animal life.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12 on skill checks that can be assisted by that specialty.

item.title: Bluff
item.description:
Bluff is the talent for misleading or deceiving through false bravado, outright lies, or displaying extreme confidence. It is the ability to make another character believe something that isn’t true.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Bluff is seen through; target becomes Hostile or Combative.
  • Failure: Patter is considered annoying and condescending.
  • Ordinary: Bluff works for the immediate scene.
  • Good: Target’s attitude improves by one grade for d8+1 time units.
  • Amazing: Target’s attitude improves by two grades for d12+2 time units.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the bluff works for the scene.
    Good Success indicates that the target’s attitude improves by one grade.
    Amazing Success indicates that the target’s attitude improves by two grades.

item.title: Burocracia
item.description: This specialty skill measures a hero’s ability to grease (or clog up) the wheels of bureaucracy. Important applications, permits, clearances, reports, or other bureaucratic requests can be processed faster and more efficiently with the use of this skill. Conversely, this skill can be used to make the same bureaucratic processes slower for others.

item.title: Buscar
item.description:
This specialty skill enables a hero to develop his eye for detail and his ability to spot hidden objects. Search is used when a hero wants to look for clues, find a particular object or person, or hunt for important objects in as fast and systematic a fashion as possible.

The degree of success achieved on a skill check determines what the hero spots after a certain amount of time spent searching.

item.title: Caer
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his ability to survive a fall by twisting his body, catching nearby protrusions, or otherwise slowing his descent, thereby decreasing the damage he sustains from an impact.

A character with the fall specialty skill adds his rank in the specialty to his Acrobatics score and uses that number to make the skill check, with a +d0 base situation die.

item.title: Cambio espacial
item.description: The ability to teleport objects or other willing characters without moving yourself.

item.title: Cantar
item.description:
The sing specialty represents a talent for carrying a note and singing songs. A hero with this skill is a trained vocalist with a strong and melodious voice.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality song.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality song.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece song.

item.title: Carrera
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his ability to move faster and cover more ground in a combat scene. A character who purchases rank 1 in this specialty immediately improves his run movement rate by 2 meters.

Rank Benefits

  • Run Rate: Increases by 2 meters at ranks 5 and 9.
  • Sprint Rate: Increases by 2 meters at ranks 4, 7, and 12.

item.title: Carterista
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to remove objects from a person (or plant something) without that person noticing. The base situation die is determined by the target’s Will resistance modifier.

Results

  • Failure/Critical Failure: The attempt fails and the pickpocketer is noticed.
  • Ordinary: The attempt succeeds.
  • Good/Amazing: The attempt succeeds and may offset penalties for repeated attempts against the same target.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 3, 6, 9, 12 [It Takes One to Know One]: The character’s Will resistance modifier (only for spotting a pickpocket attempt) improves by +1 penalty to the foe’s attempt at rank 3, +2 steps at rank 6, +3 steps at rank 9, and +4 steps at rank 12.

item.title: Carterista
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to remove objects from a person (or plant something) without that person noticing. The base situation die is determined by the target’s Will resistance modifier.

Results

  • Failure/Critical Failure: The attempt fails and the pickpocketer is noticed.
  • Ordinary: The attempt succeeds.
  • Good/Amazing: The attempt succeeds and may offset penalties for repeated attempts against the same target.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 3, 6, 9, 12 [It Takes One to Know One]: The character’s Will resistance modifier (only for spotting a pickpocket attempt) improves by +1 penalty to the foe’s attempt at rank 3, +2 steps at rank 6, +3 steps at rank 9, and +4 steps at rank 12.

item.title: chispa
item.description:
This specialty skill covers the use of all types of flintlocks, including both pistols and rifles.

It takes one action to load a flintlock pistol and a separate action to fire the weapon. It takes two actions to load a flintlock rifle, plus a separate action to fire the weapon.

item.title: Cirugía
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Surgery is used to heal mortal damage and perform other invasive medical procedures. It is a complex skill check and cannot be performed during combat scenes.

Complexity

Complexity depends on the amount of damage being treated:

  • Mortal Damage: 1pt: Marginal; 2pt: Ordinary; 3pt: Good; 4+pt: Amazing.
  • Wound Damage: 2pt: Marginal; 4pt: Ordinary; 6pt: Good; 8+pt: Amazing. Every two successes achieved heals 1 point of mortal damage and 2 points of wound damage.

Conditions

  • Critical (+4): Poor lighting, no tools, no assistance.
  • Good (-2): Modern ambulance or ship sick bay.
  • Amazing (-3): Standard hospital or advanced sick bay.
  • Best (-4): High-tech tools, trained support staff.

Rank Benefits

  • Cybernetic Surgery: At rank 3, repair or heal organisms with cybernetic implants. At rank 6, can install cybernetic implants.

item.title: Clariaudiencia / Clarividencia
item.description:
Select a location and project your mind to that spot to hear sounds (Clairaudience) or see images (Clairvoyance).

Rules

  • Duration: Ordinary: 1 round; Good: 2 rounds; Amazing: 3 rounds. Extend for 1 psionic energy point per round.
  • Constraints: Does not block normal senses (double vision/sound). Clairvoyance must be to an unobstructed location.

Distance Modifiers

  • Familiar: -1; Unfamiliar: none.
  • 1-10m: -1; 11-100m: none; 101m-1km: +1; 2-10km: +2; 11-100km: +3; 101-1,000km: +4; 1,001-10,000km: +5.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the projection lasts for 1 round.
    Good Success indicates the projection lasts for 2 rounds.
    Amazing Success indicates the projection lasts for 3 rounds.

item.title: Cognición de navegación
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Instinctively determine present location and mentally plot courses without charts or instruments. Replaces Navigation skill.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 1: Select one specialty: surface, system astrogation, or drivespace astrogation.
  • Rank 5: Select a second specialty.
  • Rank 9: Final specialty becomes available.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates plotting a course.
    Good Success indicates plotting a course.
    Amazing Success indicates plotting a course.

item.title: Comunicaciones
item.description: Operate shipboard comms, decipher codes, and jam signals.

item.title: Conocimiento de la calle
item.description: Local info about a specific city or region.

item.title: Conocimiento de la calle
item.description:
This skill enables a hero to improve his familiarity with the inner workings of a particular organization or geographical area. To improve his knowledge of more than one such organization or area, he must purchase the skill separately for each one.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero can improve his familiarity with an organization.
Good Success indicates that the hero can improve his familiarity with an organization.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero can improve his familiarity with an organization.

item.title: Conocimiento médico
item.description:
Medical Knowledge is the study of medicine and represents how up-to-date a hero is on medical techniques.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Treatment: Situation die bonus to Medical Science-treatment skill checks: -1 step at rank 2, -2 at rank 5, -3 at rank 8, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Conocimiento mundial
item.description: Specific info about a planet, system, or academic field (e.g., History, Math).

item.title: Conocimiento técnico
item.description:
This skill represents the study of technology and how up-to-date a hero is on techniques or procedures.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus to Technical Science, Invention, Juryrig, or Repair: -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Contacto
item.description:
Extended duration.

Send and receive thoughts with another character. Unwilling targets apply their Will resistance modifier as a penalty and can expel the user.

Results

  • Ordinary: Simple concepts (brief questions/one-word answers).
  • Good: Moderate discussion (pass notes every 2 phases).
  • Amazing: Detailed discussion (vocally conversing).

Distance/Mind Modifiers

  • Familiar mind: -1; Unfamiliar mind: none; Combative: +2; Hostile: +1.
  • 1-10m: -1; 11-100m: none; 101m-1km: +1; 2-10km: +2; 11-100km: +3; 101-1,000km: +4; 1,001-10,000km: +5.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates simple thought exchange.
    Good Success indicates moderate discussion.
    Amazing Success indicates detailed discussion.

item.title: Controlar el metabolismo
item.description:
Extended duration.

Through the use of this skill, a character can regulate his metabolic processes to survive without food/water, in extreme climates, or slow functions to feign death.

Hostile Environments

Result determines simulated protection:

  • Ordinary: vacuum mask
  • Good: jumpsuit
  • Amazing: soft e-suit After initial use, protection is maintained at 1 psionic energy point per hour.

item.title: Corporativo
item.description: This specialty skill enables a hero to function in the realm of large-scale trade and commerce, dealing with stock markets, mergers, corporate acquisitions, and speculative business. It also provides an understanding of how big businesses and corporations operate.

item.title: Cuchilla
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with any bladed melee weapon—a sword, knife, dagger, ax, polearm, or any other weapon that inflicts damage by either piercing or slashing an opponent with its sharp edge.

item.title: Cultura alienígena [específica]
item.description:
This specialty skill (also known as Diplomacy) allows a hero to improve his ability to reach agreements and understandings with representatives of different nations, cultures, subcultures, and species.

In general, it comes into play when a hero wants to reach an accord. The skill can only be used on a particular target if the hero has at least rank 1 in the specific Etiquette skill that pertains to the target’s culture.

item.title: Daño por transferencia
item.description:
By laying hands on another, the hero alleviates damage or disease by absorbing it into himself.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Hero suffers 1 wound.
  • Ordinary: Absorb 1 wound; reduce illness by one grade (infecting self).
  • Good: Absorb 2 wounds; reduce illness by two grades (infecting self).
  • Amazing: Absorb 3 wounds or 1 mortal; transfers any illness into self.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the hero absorbs 1 wound.
    Good Success indicates the hero absorbs 2 wounds.
    Amazing Success indicates the hero absorbs 3 wounds or 1 mortal.

item.title: Deducir
item.description:
This specialty skill enables a hero to hone his abilities to use reason and logic to reach a conclusion. It is used by detectives, scientists, engineers, and others to discover the answer to a skill-related problem.

Rank Benefits

  • Resistance Modifier: The hero’s Intelligence resistance modifier (only for deceiving the hero) improves by +1 at rank 4, by +1 again at rank 8, and by +1 again at rank 12.

item.title: Defensas
item.description: Operate shields and defensive systems. In combat, provides penalties to an opponent’s attacks.

item.title: Desarmar
item.description: The disarm skill lets a hero attempt to render bombs, mines, and other demolition packages inoperative before they explode. A hero does not need to make a skill check to disarm his own work or common explosives. Except in the very simplest of cases, a complex skill check is involved.

item.title: Dispositivos de seguridad
item.description:
Using this skill, a hero can attempt to bypass all types of mechanical or electronic security, from trip wires to motion sensors to electronic locks. It’s also used to set traps, both electronic and mechanical in nature.

One check can be made per round (or per minute in non-combat situations), and the hero is busy for the entire period.

item.title: Dominio
item.description:
This specialty skill represents the hero’s ability to lead others by virtue of sheer authoritativeness and persuasive ability. This is the skill used by military officers, elected officials, and law enforcers to issue orders and see that they’re carried out.

Command cannot be used on targets who are Combative.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates as many as two followers receive the leadership bonus.
Good Success indicates as many as four followers receive the leadership bonus.
Amazing Success indicates as many as six followers receive the leadership bonus.

item.title: electrocinética
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Cause an electrical charge to build up and direct it up to 16 meters away (range 4/8/16). Charge builds in one phase and can be released in any subsequent phase (requires second skill check). Cannot initiate other psionic skills while charge is present.

Results

  • Ordinary: d4+2s/d6+2s/d4w.
  • Good: d4+2s/d6+2s/d4w.
  • Amazing: d4+2s/d6+2s/d4w.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 5 [Increased Damage]: d6+2s/d4w/d4+2w.
  • Rank 9 [Increased Damage]: d4+2w/d6+2w/d8+2w.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates building/releasing a charge.
    Good Success indicates building/releasing a charge.
    Amazing Success indicates building/releasing a charge.

item.title: Elementos criminales
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s ability to make contact with and deal with those who are considered part of the criminal element—organized crime, professional criminals, gangs, etc. Whenever a hero tries to locate or interact with these types, he uses this skill.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero can make contact with criminal elements.
Good Success indicates that the hero can make contact with criminal elements.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero can make contact with criminal elements.

item.title: Empatía
item.description:
Read surface emotions of another character in visual contact. Assists in encounter situations.

Results

Provides understanding of emotional state (Combative, Hostile, Neutral, Friendly, Charmed, Fanatic) and a bonus when using encounter skills: -1 or -3 steps.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates reading the target’s emotions.
Good Success indicates reading the target’s emotions.
Amazing Success indicates reading the target’s emotions.

item.title: Encanto
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s ability to change the attitudes of those he interacts with by presenting himself in a likable, friendly manner.

Charm can only be used on targets whose attitude is Neutral or Friendly. A character can’t charm a Hostile or Combative target.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality charm.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality charm.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece charm.

Interaction pp = 101

item.title: Enlace de datos
item.description:
Extended duration. This skill can’t be used untrained.

Link mind with a computer or cybernetic machine without physical connection. Operates machines, projects mind into datastream, or scans storage.

Proximity Modifiers

User must be within 6 meters:

  • Up to 2m: none
  • 2-4m: +1 penalty
  • 4-6m: +2 penalty Normal computer defenses apply as a penalty.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates linking with the machine.
    Good Success indicates linking with the machine.
    Amazing Success indicates linking with the machine.

item.title: Enseñar [campo específico]
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

For each separate purchase of this specialty, the hero selects a profession (Combat Spec, Diplomat, Free Agent, or Tech Op) and becomes able to teach skills associated with that profession in addition to those belonging to the Open group.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the student pays cost -1.
Good Success indicates that the student pays cost -2.
Amazing Success indicates that the student pays cost -3.

item.title: Entrenamiento de animales
item.description: Handle and train specific types of animals (Pack, Attack, Guard). Must be purchased separately per type.

item.title: Entrenamiento de gravedad cero
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

A hero with the zero-g training skill can function in weightless or near-weightless conditions better than someone who doesn’t have this skill. An untrained character has a +3 step penalty in zero gravity and a +1 step penalty in light gravity. Purchasing this skill immediately reduces the zero-g penalty to +2 steps and eliminates the penalty for light gravity.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 4: Zero-g penalty is reduced to +1 step, and light gravity actions receive a -1 step bonus.
  • Rank 7: Zero-g penalty is eliminated.
  • Rank 10: Physical actions in zero-g receive a -1 step bonus. (Light gravity bonus never improves beyond -1 step.)

Sesheyan Advantage

Sesheyan characters without the zero-g training skill function as though they have it at rank 1. If a sesheyan purchases this skill, penalties are reduced by 1 step and bonuses are improved by the same amount (max bonus -2 in light gravity).

item.title: Entrenamiento de supervivencia
item.description: Improve survival ability in a specific terrain type (Forest, Desert, Mountain, Arctic, Jungle, Swamp, Ocean, Urban).

item.title: Entrevista
item.description:
This skill represents a hero’s ability to get information from another character in a non-aggressive way. It differs from interrogate in that the target is generally willing to share information.

Interview cannot be used on someone with a Hostile or Combative attitude toward the questioner.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality interview.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality interview.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece interview.

Interaction pp = 101

item.title: Escribiendo
item.description: This specialty skill represents a hero’s facility for communicating with the written word. Turning this skill into the basis of a career (or being able to produce work of professional quality) requires that the character pursue this specialty in his chosen field(s). The complexity of the task (e.g., a simple poem vs. a Shakespearean sonnet) is determined by the Gamemaster.

item.title: Escudo cinético
item.description:
Extended duration. This skill can’t be used untrained.

Create an invisible defensive barrier that moves with the hero, providing protection from physical attacks. Maintaining the shield gives a +1 penalty to other actions.

Results

  • Ordinary: HI +1 / LI +2
  • Good: HI +2 / LI +3
  • Amazing: HI +3 / LI +4
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the shield provides HI +1 / LI +2.
    Good Success indicates the shield provides HI +2 / LI +3.
    Amazing Success indicates the shield provides HI +3 / LI +4.

item.title: Escudo mental
item.description:
Establish a mental defense against specific psionic powers: contact, empathy, illusion, mind reading, mind blast, suggest, and tire.

Results

Check result determines penalty to opponent’s skill check:

  • Ordinary: +1
  • Good: +2
  • Amazing: +3 Remains in place for 5-8 hours (d4+4) or until it fails to stop a power.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the shield provides +1 penalty to opponents.
    Good Success indicates the shield provides +2 penalty to opponents.
    Amazing Success indicates the shield provides +3 penalty to opponents.

item.title: Espejismo
item.description:
Extended duration.

Project illusory sight or sound into a target’s mind. Usable only against visible targets; range 5 meters per skill rank. Maintaining an illusion gives a +1 penalty to other actions.

Results

Check result determines penalty to target’s Awareness-intuition check to realize it’s an illusion:

  • Ordinary: +1
  • Good: +2
  • Amazing: +3 Multiple targets provide a cumulative +1 penalty per additional target.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates projecting an illusion.
    Good Success indicates projecting an illusion.
    Amazing Success indicates projecting an illusion.

item.title: Esquivar
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to use acrobatics as a defense in combat situations. It’s also used when a hero dives for cover or hits the deck when an area-effect attack targets him. Dodge lets a hero tumble, roll, duck, dive, or spring out of the way of an attack.

One skill check (requiring an action) is made at the beginning of the first phase in which the hero can act. The result lasts for all subsequent phases in the round. Any additional actions taken in the round receive a +1 penalty.

item.title: Establecer explosivos
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his ability to set manufactured explosive charges. See the description of the Demolitions broad skill for more information.

item.title: Etiqueta [Específica]
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

For each separate purchase of this specialty, a hero selects a specific culture. As it is improved, the hero gains a stronger grasp on the customs, attitudes, and beliefs of that culture.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Effect: Gaining ranks provides a bonus to the use of Diplomacy with members of that culture: -1 bonus at rank 3, -2 bonus at rank 6, -3 bonus at rank 9, and -4 bonus at rank 12.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the hero understands the customs of a culture.
    Good Success indicates that the hero understands the customs of a culture.
    Amazing Success indicates that the hero understands the customs of a culture.

item.title: Excursión
item.description: A medium-to-long range teleportation to a known or visible location. Requires significant concentration.

item.title: Explosión mental
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Direct a blast of pure mental energy at another mind in visual contact (range 10/20/40). Armor does not protect against a mind blast.

Results

  • Ordinary: d4+1s/d4+2s/d6+2s.
  • Good: d4+1s/d4+2s/d6+2s.
  • Amazing: d4+1s/d4+2s/d6+2s.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 5 [Increased Damage]: d4+2s/d6+2s/d8+2s.
  • Rank 9 [Increased Damage]: 2d4+2s/2d6+2s/2d8+2s.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates causing mind blast damage.
    Good Success indicates causing mind blast damage.
    Amazing Success indicates causing mind blast damage.

item.title: Explosivos construidos desde cero
item.description: Cannot be used untrained.

item.title: Expresión Artística
item.description:
This specialty skill provides a hero with a well-developed sense for the aesthetically pleasing and a talent for a chosen artistic medium. Turn this skill into the basis of a career (or being able to produce work of professional quality) requires that the character pursue this specialty in his chosen field(s). The complexity of the task (e.g., a simple illustration vs. a complex masterpiece) is determined by the Gamemaster.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality piece.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality piece.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece.

item.title: Física
item.description:
Physics is the study of matter, energy, and the interactions between the two.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 step at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: forense
item.description:
Forensics is the study of causes of death and physical evidence at the scene of a crime or accident.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12 on skill checks that can be assisted by this specialty.

item.title: Fotocinética
item.description:
Excite molecules in an object to produce illumination. Takes 1 phase to reach maximum luminosity; lasts rest of round and all next round.

Results (Illumination Diameter)

  • Ordinary: 2 meters
  • Good: 4 meters
  • Amazing: 6 meters
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates illuminating a 2m area.
    Good Success indicates illuminating a 4m area.
    Amazing Success indicates illuminating a 6m area.

item.title: Fuego directo
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with direct-fire heavy weapons. These weapons work just like normal firearms, requiring the user to aim them at a target. Direct-fire heavy weapons include heavy-caliber firearms, plasma guns, and renders.

item.title: Fuego indirecto
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with indirect-fire heavy weapons. These weapons can fire over or around obstacles; they deliver an area effect attack instead of an attack against a specific target. Indirect-fire heavy weapons include grenade launchers, rocket launchers, shoulder-fired missiles, and mortars.

The accuracy of an indirect-fire weapon depends on the range and the degree of success achieved on a skill check.

Accuracy by Range

Skill Check Result Short Range Medium Range Long Range
Critical Failure Miss by 4m Miss by 8m Miss by 16m
Failure Miss by 2m Miss by 4m Miss by 8m
Ordinary On target Miss by 2m Miss by 4m
Good On target On target Miss by 2m
Amazing On target Always on target On target

item.title: ganzúa
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to open physical locks (doors, safes, vehicles, etc.). It is usually employed with tools which provide a situation die bonus.

The lockpick skill is useless against a computer-assisted lock unless it has a physical mechanism the hero can manipulate. Almost always, the use of lockpick requires a complex skill check.

item.title: ganzúa
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill allows a hero to open physical locks (doors, safes, vehicles, etc.). It is usually employed with tools which provide a situation die bonus.

The lockpick skill is useless against a computer-assisted lock unless it has a physical mechanism the hero can manipulate. Almost always, the use of lockpick requires a complex skill check.

item.title: Genética
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Genetics is the study of heredity and genes, forming the basis of genetic engineering and cloning.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12 on skill checks that can be assisted by this specialty.

item.title: Gestión
item.description: This skill indicates a hero’s ability to manage both personnel and administrative duties. A skilled manager can increase productivity, inspire workers, and supervise the workings of a business or office.

item.title: Hardware
item.description:
This specialty represents a character’s knowledge of and proficiency with the physical components of a computer, including setup, design, and repair.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 4, -2 at rank 8, and -3 at rank 12 for repairing computer systems and working with hardware.

item.title: Honda
item.description: With the sling skill, a hero can become increasingly more proficient with this type of primitive weapon. A sling can be loaded and fired in the same action by any character.

item.title: Idioma
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Every hero begins with rank 3 in his or her native language (speak and read as well as a native). Lower ranks indicate crude familiarity; higher ranks improve vocabulary and deeper comprehension.

At the Gamemaster’s discretion, a hero’s skill (or lack thereof) with a language might provide a situation die modifier to the use of other skills involving communication.

  • Rank 1: +3 penalty on communication attempts.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Communication: The penalty on communication is reduced to +1 at rank 2 and eliminated at rank 3. Rank 6 provides a -1 bonus, rank 9 a -2 bonus, and rank 12 a -3 bonus.

item.title: Ingeniería
item.description: Monitor and repair ship systems. Route power and direct remote repairs.

item.title: Inspirar
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill represents the ability to command by example. It is used to favorably alter the attitude of the target(s) toward the user of the skill.

Unlike command, inspire can be used on targets who are Hostile or Combative.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates as many as two followers receive the leadership bonus.
Good Success indicates as many as four followers receive the leadership bonus.
Amazing Success indicates as many as six followers receive the leadership bonus.

Leadership pp = 101

item.title: Instrumento musical [Específico]
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

The musical instrument skill represents a talent for playing a particular musical instrument and reading music. For each separate purchase, the hero selects a specific instrument (drums, guitars, violins, flutes, saxophones, etc.).

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality piece.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality piece.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece.

SKILLS pp = 100

item.title: Interrogar
item.description: Ask the right questions to gain information from a target.

item.title: Interrogar
item.description:
This skill represents a hero’s ability to ask the right questions to gain information from a specific target character. The character’s Will resistance modifier provides protection from probing questions.

Interrogation includes calm and reasonable debate, rhetoric, and trick questions. It may also include a hint of violence or actual pain-inducing techniques.

Results Description
Ordinary Success reveals a significant bit of information.
Good Success reveals a more significant bit of information.
Amazing Success reveals a very significant bit of information.

item.title: Intimidar
item.description:
This skill represents a hero’s ability to threaten another character, by physical presence or the weight of authority. Intimidate enables a hero to force an opponent to back down, reveal information, or cooperate through fear.

Target’s Will resistance modifier and attitude apply. It’s not possible to intimidate a Fanatic or Combative character.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality intimidation.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality intimidation.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece intimidation.

Interaction pp = 101

item.title: Intuición
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s natural instincts—his ability to sense danger when no obvious signs are evident, to avoid surprise, or to make an intuitive leap of logic.

Avoid Surprise

Success indicates that the hero isn’t surprised and can act in the surprise phase of the upcoming round.

Intuitive “Best Guess”

The Gamemaster may allow a player to call for an intuition skill check. Any success yields a beneficial result, with greater levels of success yielding more accurate and complete conclusions. This is only permitted to heroes who have purchased the specialty skill.

item.title: Invención
item.description: Invention lets a hero build an electronic or mechanical component from scratch, or modify an existing device to perform a new function. Invention checks are always complex skill checks and take time (hours, days, weeks).

item.title: Jugar
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s proficiency at various games of chance. With each purchase, the player selects a different game.

Success allows estimating odds, determining if a game is rigged, counting cards, and spotting a cheater.

Contests

If playing honestly, the winner is the one with the highest success level. Situation modifiers are based on the opponent’s skill:

  • Untrained opponent: -2 bonus.
  • Trained opponent (same or lower rank): no modifier.
  • Trained opponent (higher rank): +2 penalty.

Cheating

If a hero decides to cheat, different modifiers apply:

item.title: Jurado
item.description:
This skill enables a hero to make fast, patchwork repairs in order to get an electronic or mechanical device up and running for a short period of time. A juryrig repair can be made successfully once on a specific system.

Making a juryrig skill check is a single action, and the character can’t attempt other actions for the rest of the round.

Results

  • Critical Failure: System becomes unusable and requires full repairs.
  • Failure: Juryrig attempt doesn’t work.
  • Ordinary: Operational for d6+1 time units; 3 more successes needed for full repairs.
  • Good: Operational for 2d4+2 time units; 2 more successes needed for full repairs.
  • Amazing: Operational for 3d4+2 time units; 1 more success needed for full repairs.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Juryrig: At rank 6: Ordinary produces a Good result, Good produces an Amazing result, and Amazing success means the system is fully repaired and operational.

item.title: Lectura de la mente
item.description:
Read surface thoughts of another character in visual contact. Cannot be extended with psionic energy.

Results

  • Ordinary: Lasts 1 phase. Random/disconnected thoughts (name, what they are looking at).
  • Good: Lasts 2 phases. More detail/coherence (why they are here).
  • Amazing: Lasts 3 phases. Complete surface thoughts and a key fact.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates reading surface thoughts for 1 phase.
    Good Success indicates reading surface thoughts for 2 phases.
    Amazing Success indicates reading surface thoughts for 3 phases.

item.title: Levitación
item.description:
Extended duration.

Lift yourself into the air and propel yourself as though flying. Speed and height depend on success. Figures are doubled in light gravity and halved in heavy gravity. Performing an additional action gives a +1 penalty.

Results (Ascend per phase / Speed)

  • Ordinary: 2m / Walk x 1
  • Good: 4m / Walk x 1.5
  • Amazing: 6m / Walk x 2
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates levitating at 2m/phase and walk speed.
    Good Success indicates levitating at 4m/phase and walk x 1.5.
    Amazing Success indicates levitating at 6m/phase and walk x 2.

item.title: Ley [Específica]
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

For each separate purchase of this specialty, a hero selects a specific culture or type of law (maritime, salvage, etc.). Familiarity translates into a bonus to Law, Court Procedures, or Law Enforcement Procedures in the relevant culture.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Effect: Bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Maza
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with any bludgeoning melee weapon—a club, mace, quarterstaff, or any other weapon that inflicts damage by striking an opponent with its blunt surface.

item.title: Mente de batalla
item.description:
Extended duration. This skill can’t be used untrained.

Focus on the battle at hand. Success gives a bonus to action checks:

  • Ordinary: -1
  • Good: -2
  • Amazing: -3
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates -1 to action checks.
    Good Success indicates -2 to action checks.
    Amazing Success indicates -3 to action checks.

item.title: Montar animales
item.description: Improve stunts, racing, and mounted combat.

item.title: Nadar
item.description:
Except to determine if a hero can tread water to avoid drowning, this skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill is necessary for a hero to be able to use his swim movement rate. Without this skill, a hero can only tread water and paddle in a crude fashion.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 1 [Holding Breath]: Any Stamina-endurance checks a hero must make to keep holding his breath are made with a -1 bonus.
  • Rank 4, 8, 12 [Improved Breathing]: The bonus to Stamina-endurance checks improves to -2 (rank 4), -3 (rank 8), and -4 (rank 12).
  • Rank 4, 8, 12 [Movement Rate]: Both swim and easy swim rates increase by 1 meter at each of these ranks.

item.title: Navegación, Superficie
item.description:
This specialty skill is the study and performance of navigation on a planetary surface using stars, landmarks, and specialized equipment.

Surface Navigation Results

  • Critical Failure/Failure: Consult “System/Surface Off Course Results”.
  • Ordinary: Course is plotted at normal travel time plus d4 time units.
  • Good: Course is plotted at normal travel time.
  • Amazing: Course is plotted that cuts travel time by 1 time unit.

item.title: Negociar
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s ability to make and close deals. It provides the skills to haggle, negotiate, and bluster.

Situation modifiers include supply and demand, as well as the target’s Will resistance modifier. The greater the degree of success, the better the deal for the hero.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality deal.
Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality deal.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece deal.

item.title: Negocios ilícitos
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to function in the underside of the business world, including extortion, smuggling, fencing stolen goods, and dealing with the black market. It also covers white-collar crime like embezzlement and corporate spying.

Having this skill reduces the penalty for attempting an illegal transaction by -1 step initially.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Penalty reduction improves to -2 steps at rank 4, -3 steps at rank 7, and -4 steps at rank 10. (Never provides a bonus, only reduces penalties.)

item.title: Neumático
item.description:
Inflict fatigue damage on a target in visual contact (range 10/20/30).

Results

  • Ordinary: 1 fatigue point
  • Good: 2 points
  • Amazing: 3 points
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates inflicting 1 fatigue point.
    Good Success indicates inflicting 2 fatigue points.
    Amazing Success indicates inflicting 3 fatigue points.

item.title: Ocultar
item.description:
This specialty skill represents the ability to hide objects from view or sensors. While Stealth is used to hide oneself, Conceal is used to hide items, such as weapons on one’s person, contraband in a vehicle, or a secret compartment in a room.

Results

The degree of success on a Conceal check provides a penalty to an observer’s Awareness-perception or Investigate-search check to find the hidden object:

  • Ordinary: +1 penalty to observer
  • Good: +2 penalty to observer
  • Amazing: +3 penalty to observer

Hiding Weapons

A concealed weapon is worn in a place not normally searched or not subject to easy spotting (the small of the back, inside of the forearm, etc.). The concealed weapon must be either a small handgun or a blade. Concealment provides a +2 penalty to all but the most intrusive searches.

item.title: Ocultar
item.description:
Disguise is the ability to change your appearance to look like someone else or to blend into a crowd.

While the Entertainment-act skill is used for professional makeup and performance, this specialty covers more immediate and practical applications of disguise, such as changing clothes, wearing a wig, or using simple props to avoid recognition.

A hero’s Disguise situation die is modified by the observer’s Awareness-perception modifier.

item.title: Operación de la computadora
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This skill allows a character to improve his ability to make computers perform, specifically his ability to get the most out of software (including the operating system). The degree of success achieved relates to the quality or quantity of the information accessed or retrieved, or the speed of performance.

item.title: Parpadear
item.description: A short-range, combat-effective jump within line of sight. Used to dodge attacks or reposition instantly.

item.title: Pelearse
item.description: This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency in brawling. Brawling is the art of unarmed, hand-to-hand combat that can be as undisciplined as street fighting or as studied as boxing or wrestling.

item.title: Pequeñas empresas
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to function in the pursuit of small-scale trade and commerce. It improves a hero’s ability to haggle on the consumer level, determine the value of goods and services, and find buyers and sellers in a specific area.

This skill provides a situation die bonus when a character attempts to make deals, haggle, or otherwise bargain in the pursuit of small-business finance. The bonus starts at -1 step.

item.title: Percepción
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s alertness and powers of observation using normal senses—a broken twig, the click of a gun’s safety, the scent of perfume.

Avoid Surprise

When potential danger obviously exists, a hero’s subconscious use of this skill can help him avoid being caught by surprise. Success indicates that the hero isn’t surprised and can act in the surprise phase of the upcoming round.

Results Description
Ordinary Success indicates that the hero isn’t surprised and can act in the surprise phase.
Good Success indicates that the hero isn’t surprised and can act in the surprise phase.
Amazing Success indicates that the hero isn’t surprised and can act in the surprise phase.

item.title: Pionero
item.description:
With trailblazing, a hero learns to find paths through rough terrain or create paths that others can use to move faster and cover more ground during a full day’s travel.

The successful use of this skill reduces the adverse effects of traveling in conditions of Good or Amazing difficulty for the hero and any companions who are traveling with him.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Route is worse than normal; everyone suffers an additional +1 penalty to fatigue checks.
  • Failure: No help is provided.
  • Ordinary: Reduction of 1 step to any penalties.
  • Good: Reduces penalties by 2 steps.
  • Amazing: Reduces penalties by 3 steps.

item.title: Pirocinética
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Excite molecules within an object or the air to cause fire. Range 10/20/30 (penalties at medium/long range). Target catches fire in the following phase.

Flash Fire Storm

Target the air for effect similar to incendiary grenade. Damage reduced for targets within 2m (-2), 4m (-3), and 6m (-4).

Results

  • Ordinary: d4+2w/d6+2w/d8+2w.
  • Good: d4+2w/d6+2w/d8+2w.
  • Amazing: d4+2w/d6+2w/d8+2w.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 5 [Increased Damage]: d6+2w/d8+2w/d4m.
  • Rank 9 [Increased Damage]: d8+2w/d4m/d4+2m.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates causing fire damage.
    Good Success indicates causing fire damage.
    Amazing Success indicates causing fire damage.

item.title: Pista
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to follow a person, creature, or land vehicle by noting the tracks (footprints, broken branches, discarded litter, etc.) left in its wake. It is used to locate and follow a trail, either a physical one or a trail of information.

Physical tracking slows movement to half the normal movement rate.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Trail is completely lost and can’t be picked up again.
  • Failure: Trail is lost but can be rediscovered.
  • Ordinary: Follow trail for 2 time units before needing another check.
  • Good: Next check is not necessary until 3 time units later.
  • Amazing: Next check is not necessary until 4 time units later.

Track can also be used to obscure a hero’s trail. Success affects the opposing tracker’s situation modifier: Critical Failure: -3 bonus; Failure: -1 bonus; Ordinary: +1 penalty; Good: +2; Amazing: +3.

item.title: Pistola
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with modern pistols of all types, including projectile and energy weapons.

If a hero wants to draw and fire his pistol in the same phase, the action receives a +1 penalty.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 3 [Quick Draw]: Perform a quick draw and fire in the same phase without the +1 penalty.
  • Other Benefits: See Ranged Weapons Rank Benefits.

item.title: Planetología
item.description:
Planetology is the study of new celestial bodies, specifically when attempting to classify, log, and scan for useful information.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 step at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Postcognición / Precognición
item.description:
Receive impressions about the past (Postcognition) or future (Precognition).

Results

  • Ordinary: Sense general emotions (past) or vague images (future).
  • Good: Brief flashes of events.
  • Amazing: Brief encounter as though at the scene.

Postcognition

See time units (hours/days) into the past equal to skill rank.

Precognition

See time units (hours/days) into the future equal to skill rank. Usually GM-triggered.

  • Forcing a flash: Cost is doubled (2/4/6 pts); +3 penalty; cannot use consciously again for 2d6 days.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates vague images/emotions.
    Good Success indicates brief flashes.
    Amazing Success indicates a brief encounter as though at the scene.

item.title: Prestidigitación
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to become proficient in stage magic, also known as prestidigitation. In addition to entertaining others, the skill can also be used to slip small objects out of sight.

Results

  • Critical Failure: The hero drops the item he is manipulating or otherwise fumbles the task severely.
  • Failure: The manipulation takes place, but the task is performed clumsily or slowly enough that anyone paying attention can see what happened.
  • Ordinary/Good/Amazing: The trick or task is pulled off without a hitch.

item.title: Primer encuentro
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill represents training in the theories and protocols of making first contact with a previously unknown culture. With this skill, a hero can assess capabilities, establish communications, and study cultural habits.

Complex Task

A first encounter skill check is always a complex chore that may take days, weeks, or months. The Gamemaster determines the number of successes needed based on how different the cultures are.

item.title: Primeros auxilios
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill represents basic training in first aid techniques, including the use of trauma packs and first aid kits. It doesn’t provide a hero with the ability to use surgical tools or specialized gauntlets.

Heal Stun Damage

Successful skill check restores 2 (Ordinary), 3 (Good), or 4 (Amazing) stun points to a conscious patient.

Knockout Recovery

Successful skill check brings a character back to consciousness and recovers 1 (Ordinary), 2 (Good), or 3 (Amazing) stun points.

item.title: Procedimientos de aplicación de la ley
item.description: Police officers, detectives, bounty hunters, and others use this skill to follow (or bend) legal law enforcement procedures. Topics include surveillance, search and seizure, arrest and detainment, and report writing. This specialty is also used to determine how “good” an arrest is.

item.title: Procedimientos judiciales
item.description: Lawyers, judges, and others use this skill to interact in a courtroom setting. This specialty is used to argue a case or point of view in an official proceeding.

item.title: Programación
item.description:
This specialty skill enables a hero to analyze computer programs, modify existing programs, and create programs by writing her own code.

Having rank 1 in this skill enables a character to modify the source code of programs of Ordinary quality and Ordinary complexity.

Rank Benefits

  • Modify Existing Programs: At rank 3, able to modify code of programs of Good quality and Good complexity. At rank 6, can modify any existing program.
  • Create New Programs: At rank 3, create new programs of Marginal quality and Marginal complexity. Ordinary programs at rank 6, Good programs at rank 9, and Amazing programs at rank 12.

item.title: Protocolos de protección
item.description:
This skill represents training in protection procedures of all types.

Secure an Area

With time and cooperation, a hero can set defenses. The success affects subsequent Awareness checks of guards:

  • Critical Failure: +1 penalty
  • Failure: no modifier
  • Ordinary: -1 bonus
  • Good: -2 bonus
  • Amazing: -3 bonus

Analyze Weak Points

Study a secured area for weak points to exploit. The analysis check is modified by the area’s security:

  • No security: no modifier
  • Marginal: +1 penalty
  • Ordinary: +2 penalty
  • Good: +3 penalty
  • Amazing: +4 penalty Success provides bonuses to subsequent skill checks to force entry: Ordinary: -1; Good: -2; Amazing: -3.

item.title: Psicología
item.description:
Psychology is the study of mental processes and behavior, and the treatment of mental aberrations and disease.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12 on skill checks that can be assisted by this specialty.

item.title: Psicometría
item.description:
Read psychic impressions from inanimate objects through touch. Tools, weapons, clothing, and dead bodies can be studied. Living creatures or casually encountered objects (dirt) are not affected.

Results

  • Ordinary: Simple emotions associated with object.
  • Good: Simple images associated with object.
  • Amazing: Brief encounter as though the hero were the person using the object.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates reading simple emotions.
    Good Success indicates reading simple images.
    Amazing Success indicates a brief encounter as though the hero were the person using the object.

item.title: Psicoquinética
item.description:
Extended duration.

Move objects with the mind. Lift up to Will x 10 kg; push up to Will x 20 kg. Figures are doubled in light gravity and halved in heavy gravity.

Results (Lift / Push per phase in meters)

  • Ordinary: 1 / 2
  • Good: 2 / 4
  • Amazing: 3 / 6
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates moving object at 1m lift / 2m push.
    Good Success indicates moving object at 2m lift / 4m push.
    Amazing Success indicates moving object at 3m lift / 6m push.

item.title: Pulla
item.description:
This specialty skill represents a hero’s ability to trade insults with the best of them. A successful taunt can rattle or even enrage an opponent, causing them to perform an action against their best interest.

Taunt has no effect on a Charmed or Fanatic target.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Target uses the taunt to fuel rage, receiving a -2 bonus to their next action.
  • Failure: The taunt has no effect.
  • Ordinary: Effective, providing a +1 penalty to the target’s next action.
  • Good: Target is rattled, receiving a +2 penalty to their next action.
  • Amazing: Target is enraged, receiving a +3 penalty to their next action and shifts one grade in attitude toward Combative.

Only one successful taunt can be directed at a target in a scene.

item.title: Química
item.description:
Chemistry is the study of the composition, structure, properties, and reactions of matter.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 step at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Rejuvenecer
item.description:
A character can offset fatigue or stun damage (but not psionic energy loss). Body’s reaction lasts one hour; cannot be attempted more than once per hour.

Results

Check provides “rejuvenation points” (2 per fatigue, 1 per stun):

  • Ordinary: 2 points
  • Good: 4 points
  • Amazing: 6 points Points must be used immediately or lost.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the hero receives 2 rejuvenation points.
    Good Success indicates the hero receives 4 rejuvenation points.
    Amazing Success indicates the hero receives 6 rejuvenation points.

item.title: Reparar
item.description:
This skill provides a hero with training in the repair and maintenance of mechanical and electronic technology. Any use of repair requires a complex skill check.

Complexity

  • Stun Damage: Ordinary complexity.
  • Wound Damage: Good complexity.
  • Mortal Damage: Amazing complexity (may require more than 10 successes). The time unit is designated by the Gamemaster (minutes, hours, days, etc.).

item.title: Resistencia
item.description: As a hero acquires ranks in the endurance skill, he becomes more able to withstand the effects of damage. For a character who has this specialty, endurance checks take the place of Stamina checks.

item.title: Resistir el dolor
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Resist pain allows a hero to function normally and ignore some or all of the situation penalties for suffering stun, wound, or mortal damage. A check does not count as an action.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Hero succumbs to the pain and can’t act for 2d4 phases.
  • Failure: Hero suffers from damage penalties.
  • Ordinary: Hero ignores 1 step of penalty.
  • Good: Hero ignores 2 steps of penalty.
  • Amazing: Hero ignores 3 steps of penalty.

Resist pain only lessens or eliminates situation penalties caused by cumulative damage. It doesn’t turn a penalty into a bonus or stave off dying or death.

item.title: Resolución física
item.description: Cope with physical trauma and determination to resist torture or exhaustion.

item.title: Resolución física
item.description:
This specialty skill is used to determine a hero’s ability to cope with physical trauma of all kinds, including torture, pain, and damage.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Break under torture and reveal everything.
  • Failure: Break under torture and reveal at least one fact.
  • Ordinary: Withstand torture for d4 time units.
  • Good: Withstand torture for d6+2 time units.
  • Amazing: Withstand torture for 2d4+3 time units.

Knockout Recovery

After being knocked out, a character makes checks to regain consciousness:

item.title: Resolución mental
item.description: Cope with emotional or mental stress (trauma, fear, madness, mind control).

item.title: Resolución mental
item.description:
This specialty skill is used to determine a hero’s ability to cope with emotional or mental stress. The higher a hero’s rank in mental resolve, the more resistant he is to trauma, fear, mind control, and mental powers.

Results

  • Critical Failure: The hero collapses in anguish and can’t act, or flees in the face of extreme fear for d4 rounds.
  • Failure: The hero freezes and loses one action.
  • Ordinary: The hero can act normally but receives a +1 penalty to all actions for 1 round.
  • Good/Amazing: The hero puts aside his negative emotions and can act without penalty.

Rank Benefits

  • Resistance Modifier: The hero’s Will resistance modifier improves by +1 at rank 4, by +1 again at rank 8, and by +1 again at rank 12.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the hero can act normally but receives a +1 penalty for 1 round.
    Good Success indicates that the hero can act normally without penalty.
    Amazing Success indicates that the hero can act normally without penalty.

item.title: Rifle
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with modern rifles and shotguns of all types.

Some rifles are automatic weapons capable of firing multiple rounds of ammunition in every attack.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 3 [Improved Aim]: Hit a target with more dependability, providing a -1 bonus to the situation die for any rifle attack.
  • Rank 6 [Precision Shooting]: Situation die penalties for making an autofire attack are reduced to 0, +1 step, and +2 steps.
  • Other Benefits: See Ranged Weapons Rank Benefits.

item.title: Saltar
item.description:
With the jump skill, a hero can attempt to leap over obstacles by performing a horizontal running or standing jump, or a vertical leap.

On any jumping attempt, a Critical Failure result indicates that the hero trips and takes a hard fall, suffering d6 points of stun damage. A Marginal indicates that the hero makes a leap of Ordinary distance but suffers d4 points of stun damage because of a poor landing.

item.title: Sanar
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

By concentrating, a character can heal himself of wound damage or disease. Results are immediate but the body’s reaction lasts one hour; cannot be attempted more than once per hour.

Results

  • Ordinary: 1 wound point; reduce disease by one grade.
  • Good: 2 wound points; reduce disease by two grades.
  • Amazing: 3 wound points; reduce disease by three grades.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 6 [Healing Mortal Damage]: Able to heal mortal damage. Results change to: Ordinary: 2 wounds; Good: 3 wounds or 1 mortal; Amazing: 4 wounds or 2 mortals.

item.title: Seco
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Hacking is the ability to break computer codes and bypass computer security to gain access to restricted data or systems. It’s used to retrieve secured data, take control of a system, or perform sabotage.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 4, -2 at rank 8, and -3 at rank 12.

item.title: Seducir
item.description:
This skill represents the ability to entice or beguile another character through opening lines, witty exchanges, and emotional manipulation. The final goal is to gain trust or cooperation through romantic overtures.

Seduce can only be used on Friendly or better targets. Achieve an Ordinary result or better to accomplish the seduction.

Results

How long a character remains seduced depends on the check:

  • Charmed: Seduction works well enough to lead to serious feelings if feigned interest continues (successful check once per week).
  • Fanatic: Target falls in love or becomes obsessed. Every time a favor is asked, the target makes a Will feat check with a modifier (+1 for Charmed, +2 for Fanatic). Success shifts the attitude one grade toward Neutral. Once it reaches Friendly, the target is no longer behaving as though seduced.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the hero produced a quality seduction.
    Good Success indicates that the hero produced a very quality seduction.
    Amazing Success indicates that the hero produced a masterpiece seduction.

Interaction pp = 101

item.title: Sensibilidad
item.description:
Consciously realize when a psionic skill is being used in the vicinity. Costs 2 energy points to activate; lasts 1 minute. Maintain for 1 pt/minute.

Results

  • Ordinary: Aware of psionic skill within 20m and identifying the source character.
  • Good: Identify the broad skill(s) being used.
  • Amazing: Identify the exact specialty skill(s) being used.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates awareness of psionic use within 20m.
    Good Success indicates identifying the broad skill(s).
    Amazing Success indicates identifying the exact specialty skill(s).

item.title: Sensores
item.description: Operate sensor arrays. Provide data bonuses to weapons or defenses.

item.title: Sigilo
item.description:
This specialty (also known as Unified Stealth) merges the techniques of hide, sneak, and shadow into a single field of expertise. It is the art of remaining undetected while stationary or in motion.

Hide (Stationary)

Ability to stay unnoticed by keeping quiet and still using cover or darkness.

  • Results: Degree of success gives observer penalty: Ordinary (+1), Good (+2), Amazing (+3).

Sneak (In Motion)

Ability to move silently (up to one-half walk rate).

item.title: Soborno
item.description:
Bribe is used when a hero wants to offer another character money, goods, information, or services to get what he wants.

Results

  • Critical Failure: Bribe is refused; target becomes Hostile or Combative.
  • Failure: Bribe is refused; each subsequent attempt must raise the value.
  • Ordinary: Bribe is accepted, but the attitude of the target is unchanged.
  • Good: Bribe is accepted; the target’s attitude improves by one grade for 2d6 hours.
  • Amazing: Bribe is accepted; the target’s attitude improves by two grades for 4d6 hours.
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates that the bribe is accepted.
    Good Success indicates that the target’s attitude improves by one grade.
    Amazing Success indicates that the target’s attitude improves by two grades.

item.title: subfusil
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to improve his proficiency with modern submachine guns of all types.

All SMGs are automatic weapons capable of firing multiple rounds of ammunition in every attack.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 3 [Rock-n-Roll]: Change clips more efficiently. The penalty for changing a clip and firing in the same action is reduced to +1 step.
  • Rank 6 [Precision Shooting]: Situation die penalties for making an autofire attack with an SMG are reduced to 0, +1 step, and +2 steps.
  • Rank 9 [Extra Burst]: Get off four bursts of ammunition instead of three on every autofire attack. He receives a fourth situation die with a +3 penalty assigned to it.
  • Other Benefits: See Ranged Weapons Rank Benefits.

item.title: Sugerir
item.description:
Plants a thought into another person’s mind and convinces them it’s their own. Cannot have permanent or immediately detrimental effects.

Results

Check result determines duration:

  • Ordinary: 1 hour
  • Good: 2 hours
  • Amazing: 3 hours Target makes a Will feat check after it wears off to realize it was a suggestion (penalty/bonus is reverse of original skill check modifier).
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the suggestion lasts for 1 hour.
    Good Success indicates the suggestion lasts for 2 hours.
    Amazing Success indicates the suggestion lasts for 3 hours.

item.title: Tácticas de infantería
item.description: Ground-based combat involving individual troops.

item.title: Tácticas de vehículos
item.description: Combat involving air, land, or water vehicles.

item.title: Tácticas espaciales
item.description: Combat between spaceships.

item.title: Temerario
item.description:
This specialty skill enables a hero to perform high-risk activities such as skydiving, scuba diving, hang gliding, surfing, bungee jumping, and whitewater rafting.

Results

  • Critical Failure: The action fails and the character could suffer stun or wound damage (equipment failure).
  • Failure: The action doesn’t succeed, but the character does not necessarily suffer damage (e.g., landing off course).
  • Ordinary: The character performs the action but with minimal control.
  • Good: The character has limited control and executes the action well.
  • Amazing: Everything goes right; the action is executed perfectly without damage.

item.title: Tirar
item.description:
With the throw skill, a hero can accurately toss balls, darts, stones, throwing knives, grenades, and other small objects at a specific target.

The accuracy of a throw depends on the range and the degree of success achieved on a skill check.

Accuracy by Range

Skill Check Result Short Range Medium Range Long Range
Critical Failure Miss by 4m Miss by 8m Miss by 16m
Failure Miss by 2m Miss by 4m Miss by 8m
Ordinary On target Miss by 2m Miss by 4m
Good On target On target Miss by 2m
Amazing On target Always on target On target

item.title: transformar
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

By using this skill, a character can alter his physical features for disguise or to accomplish tasks (squeeze into small holes, increase reach). Requires an entire round (4 phases) to complete. Mass doesn’t change, but volume can.

Results

Check determines initial duration:

  • Ordinary: 1 round
  • Good: 2 rounds
  • Amazing: 3 rounds Extend for 1 psionic energy point per round.

Rank Benefits

  • Rank 1 & 3: Select one: Elongate fingers (+0.5m reach), Elongate arms (+1m reach), Elongate legs (+1m height).
  • Rank 5 & 7: Select one: Disguise (+2 penalty to Awareness to recognize), Elongate arms and legs simultaneously, Elongate entire body (pass through 0.5m openings).
  • Rank 10 & 12: Select one: Improved disguise (+4 penalty to Awareness), Lessen damage (flexible body reduces LI damage: Ordinary d4, Good d4+2, Amazing d6+2), Morph control (any two forms simultaneously).
    Results Description
    Ordinary Success indicates the form lasts for 1 round.
    Good Success indicates the form lasts for 2 rounds.
    Amazing Success indicates the form lasts for 3 rounds.

item.title: Tratamiento
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

The treatment specialty can be used for all tasks first aid covers, but with greater effectiveness.

Heal Damage

  • Stun Damage: Restores 2, 3, or 4 points to a conscious patient.
  • Knockout Recovery: Recovers 2, 3, or 4 stun points.
  • Wound Damage: Complex skill check using a first aid kit (Ordinary complexity, 2 wounds healed) or trauma pack (Marginal complexity, 4 wounds healed).
  • Dying: Stabilizes mortal damage, increasing the time between Stamina-endurance checks from one per hour to one per day.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Treatment: Situation die penalty reduction: -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12.

item.title: Trepar
item.description:
This specialty skill allows a hero to scale walls, ascend mountains, or otherwise climb up or over obstacles.

In combat scenes, a hero can climb a certain number of meters in a phase, depending on the result of a skill check:

  • Critical Failure: fall (if possible)
  • Marginal: no progress this action
  • Ordinary: 1 meter
  • Good: 2 meters
  • Amazing: 3 meters

In challenge scenes or whenever the Gamemaster determines that a time unit other than rounds applies, a climb check is a complex skill check.

item.title: Vehículo acuático
item.description: This specialty skill enables a hero to become trained in the use of a specific type of water vehicle (e.g., sailboats, jet skis, large commercial vessels, submersible craft). If he wants to be skilled in more than one type, he must purchase each separately. This skill is also used to operate the helm of large, multicrewed water vessels.

item.description:

This specialty skill enables a hero to become trained in the use of a specific type of air vehicle (e.g., propeller planes, helicopters, jet fighters). If he wants to be skilled in more than one type, he must purchase each separately.

item.title: xenología
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

Xenology is the study of animal life forms of an alien nature and can be used to identify or classify such life forms, including alien plant life. It allows a character to make educated guesses as to the nature, behavior, and abilities of alien life forms.

Rank Benefits

  • Increased Effect: Situation die bonus of -1 at rank 3, -2 at rank 6, -3 at rank 9, and -4 at rank 12 on skill checks that can be assisted by this specialty.

item.title: Xenomedicina [Específica]
item.description:
This skill can’t be used untrained.

This specialty skill involves the medical study of a specific alien species, allowing a hero to use his other medical skills on members of that species. Initially, a +3 step penalty is applied to healing alien characters.

Rank Benefits

  • Improved Treatment: Penalty reduction to +2 at rank 3, +1 at rank 6, eliminated at rank 9, and -1 bonus at rank 12.
